title: Semiramis I
summary: Queen of the chroniclers, wife of Ninus (Nimrod).
description: Queen of the chroniclers, wife of Ninus (Nimrod). Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-47: The Reign of Ninyas Zames/Gilgamesh: 2006–1968 B.C."
reign.note: Her 42-year reign, "triangulated" in CFAH-3 (AP-21, on the event reign-of-semiramis-i).

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-15: Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon," OSF preprint v1.4 (2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/VYNJU, file CFAH-15 Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon_v1.4.pdf, Table 5 "Baseline Reigns for Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon: Uruk I", p. 52
reign.note: Row "Dumuzi / Semiramis" of Table 5 (Uruk I dynasty). Printed "Dumuzi / Semiramis".

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 91; Castor, ap. Eusebius
reign.note: Semiramis, after the death of Ninus. The fragment does not say "Semiramis I". The person record's CFAH note states "Her 42-year reign". The fragment prints the same length and no BC year.

free_source_links.locator: "AP-47: The Reign of Ninyas Zames/Gilgamesh: 2006–1968 B.C."
